tmp:1810: ma'alin et ha-yirah — the act of elevating fear to its root by judging one's own affairs (mishpat), from 'a king by justice establishes the land'
tmp:1811: sheshet yemei ha-ma'aseh — the six weekdays of creation, the aspect of practical mitzvah-deeds through which World-Year-Soul were created
tmp:1812: ma'aseh ha-mitzvot — the practical performance of the commandments, identified with the six days of work in which World-Year-Soul were created
tmp:1813: inheritance of Eretz Yisrael achieved by drawing down the Land of Israel's holiness ('sit at My right hand') — the means that fells the wicked
tmp:1814: mapaltan shel resha'im — the downfall/collapse of the wicked, effected through inheriting the holiness of the Land of Israel (Abba Shaul's 'deer' chase)
tmp:1816: mefursam — the famous/renowned person, one's public name and reputation (equated with the nefesh), which can be 'lost' though everyone speaks of him
tmp:1817: tapuchin — the 'apples' (of the holy Apple Field), symbol of the openings of the heart when the supernal heart's mercy is stirred and warm words flow
tmp:1818: maftechei ha-lev she-niftachim — the keys/openings of the heart being opened, i.e., the supernal heart's compassion kindled to pour forth warm speech
tmp:1819: Mei Merivah — the biblical 'Waters of Strife' (Numbers 20), read as the aspect of matzah/quarrel (matsuta) of the tzaddikim
tmp:1820: the Zoharic letter-operation making matzah from the letters of chametz — breaking the chet of 'kaneh' into a heh so one's wisdom does not ferment
tmp:1821: the protective power of tzedakah (charity) as a segulah that saves one from lustful thoughts of adultery — though one may not rely on it to mingle with women
tmp:1822: metzulot — the 'depths' of the sea (Exodus 15:5), read as Mitzrayim/Egypt via 'va-yenatzlu et Mitzrayim' (despoiling Egypt)
tmp:1824: azut di-kedushah she-yesh bo — the holy boldness a person possesses, opposite of brazen-facedness, prerequisite for a portion in Torah
tmp:1825: receiving holy boldness (azut di-kedushah) from Hashem — the divine grant of sacred audacity needed to receive Torah
tmp:1826: meriting good deeds and good character traits (middot tovot) through contraction and good thoughts — the achievement that reveals God's kingship
tmp:1827: accepting upon oneself the complete yoke of the Kingdom of Heaven (kabbalat ol malkhut shamayim shelemah) — the state attained via good deeds and traits
tmp:1828: binding one's heart to one's da'at ('his heart in his control') — the act of subordinating the heart to the mind above time
tmp:1829: the middot (character traits) receiving the light of the love-within-Da'at — supra-temporal Chesed flowing into the traits when heart is bound to mind
tmp:1830: mikveh of Shavuot — the festival immersion-pool corresponding to the Fiftieth Gate, highest of the fifty gates of Binah (per the Shavuot kavvanot)
tmp:1831: mekomot ha-nemukhim — the low places, i.e., the filthy places (mekomot ha-metunafim) of extreme spiritual descent where one can still recall God through speech
tmp:1833: fulfilling the positive commandment of 'Ve-ahavta' (loving God), root of all positive mitzvot, achieved by conducting business in faithfulness
tmp:1835: 've-hatznea lekhet' — the verse-phrase 'walk humbly [with your God]' (Micah 6:8), identified as the encompassing lights (makifim) and the sukkah
tmp:1836: Atika — the Zoharic 'Ancient One' (Atika Kadisha), the partzuf that is utterly hidden, symbolizing the makifin concealed until the future revelation
tmp:1838: mikneihu — 'his livestock' (as in Exodus 9:20-21), the domestic animals whose untimely death results from laxity in the mitzvah of sukkah
tmp:1839: cooling one's bodily heat by means of leshon ha-kodesh — the Holy Tongue's power to chill lustful heat ('my heart was hot within me... I spoke')
tmp:1840: one who sanctifies himself — the person whose free choice of self-sanctification binds him to the rope (chevel) of holiness
tmp:1841: binding oneself to the rope of holiness (chevel di-kedushah) — the attachment effected by self-sanctification, opposite the rope of impurity
tmp:1842: mar'ah meluteshet — a polished mirror, symbol of the student's shining countenance (anpin nehirin) enabling him to receive the light of his master's face
tmp:1844: omer — the Omer barley offering, letter-rearranged as Mordekhai/'mar deror' (pure myrrh), signifying freedom (cherut) and revealed Torah
tmp:1845: being sent compassion so that he will have mercy on another — God's device of giving a needy person someone to pity
tmp:1846: merachamin alav — Heaven having mercy upon him, the reciprocal mercy earned by one who shows mercy to another (whoever pities creatures is pitied)
tmp:1847: 'Ki Tetze' — the verse-phrase 'When you go out' (Deut. 21:10), read as the aspect of commerce/business ('Rejoice, Zevulun, in your going out')
tmp:1848: expertise in dinei mamonot — monetary law study ('who wishes to grow wise, engage in monetary laws'), equated with faithful commerce renewing the mind/soul
tmp:1849: niguna de-Leiva'ei — the Zoharic 'melody of the Levites' that gladdens the heart, identified with faithful commerce done in contentment with one's lot
tmp:1850: cheshek — intense desire/yearning, the longing that all obstacles exist to intensify and that forms the vowel-points bringing potential into actuality
tmp:1851: the desire's breaking of the obstacle — cheshek shattering the meniah, since obstacles exist only to arouse greater longing
tmp:1852: breaking through the encircling klipah and entering the second rung — piercing the husk surrounding each spiritual level by joy of the mitzvah
tmp:1853: the holy boldness required, namely the aforementioned voices/cries — azut di-kedushah of voice that breaks the body's brazenness (a sigh breaks the body)
tmp:1855: 'to build them the Beit ha-Bechirah' — the commandment to build the Temple, read as the aspect of Moshe/Da'at ('one with da'at, it is as if the Temple were built in his days')
tmp:1857: telat me'ah — the 'three hundred' (barrels of oil in the Rabbah bar bar Chanah tale), symbol of Moshe/'mah': the tzaddik's threefold self-diminution in wisdom, might, and wealth
